pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark brown polygonal patches on the neck and upper shoulder with sharp, angular edges and well-defined vertices. Patch geometry is predominantly quadrilateral and pentagonal with high-contrast pixel gradients at the boundaries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of cream-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological graph with clear triradiate junction nodes. The pixel thickness of these corridors is narrow and relatively uniform across the visible neck area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, upright mane is visible along the dorsal neck ridge, exhibiting a finely serrated 1D silhouette with low-amplitude and high-frequency hair-tip peaks against the background foliage.
